headline: Colonial Gains in Weathered Expanse as Callahan's Passage Erupts
war_summary: Since the morning bulletin, the central and eastern sectors have seen substantial tactical movement. Colonial forces in Weathered Expanse reclaimed two previously shattered positions, elevating their garrison count to seven bases and reducing vacant no-man's-land to two amidst escalating firefights that claimed over a thousand casualties in two hours. To the southwest, Callahan's Passage has erupted violently, registering eight base exchanges in the last two hours between The Crumbling Passage and Crumbling Post, though Wardens retain nine strongpoints to the Colonials' one. Action persists across Stlican Shelf, where further contest over Briar left the map divided between seven Colonial garrisons, one Warden redoubt, and a single neutral ruin. In Mooring County, an intense clash flared without immediate territorial alterations, inflicting nearly nine hundred casualties in two hours as rates surged. Conversely, the earlier flare-up in Stonecradle subsided with zero base shifts over the last two hours, while Nevish Line logged only a solitary turnover despite climbing casualty tempos across both ranks.
